The main takeaway from our work is that

the ISMR variability is strongly influenced by the local feedbacks between the atmosphere and the ocean, and the representation of the ISV modes is crucial to improve the simulation the IAV of the ISMR.
the coupled model is able to reproduce the main features of the ISMR and its variability, but it is not yet able to capture the complex air sea feedback processes that modulate the ISMR.
